newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan recovery slow, needs vigilance - Hashimoto.
newsitem.headline: Japan recovery slow, needs vigilance - Hashimoto.

text.p: The pace of Japan's economic recovery remains slow and it still requires careful vigilance, Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Tuesday.

In a speech to a convention of non-life insurers, Hashimoto said: "Fortunately, the private sector is increasing its strength and the economy continues to recover. However, at the moment, the tempo is gradual and the jobs situation is still severe despite some improvement."
"It is necessary to closely watch over the future direction of the economy," Hashimoto said.
He added that an ageing society and the globalisation of economies meant Japan must change its "overall system" and press forward with structural reforms in its economy, administration and society.
In relation to the economy, Hashimoto cited the need for a more transparent financial system, better use of land and further deregulation.
